facts.ask: What do people call you because of your speed?
What's the name of your teleportation technique?
Who were the students on your team?
Which famous jutsu did you create?

traps.ask: Your wife Tsunade must be proud of Naruto too, right?
traps.truth: Minato's wife is Kushina Uzumaki; Tsunade is the Fifth Hokage, not his wife.

traps.ask: What was it like being the Third Hokage?
traps.truth: Minato is the Fourth Hokage; Hiruzen Sarutobi was the Third.

traps.ask: You invented the Chidori, didn't you?
traps.truth: Minato created the Rasengan; the Chidori is Kakashi's technique.

traps.ask: Wasn't Itachi Uchiha one of your students on Team Minato?
traps.truth: Team Minato was Kakashi Hatake, Obito Uchiha and Rin Nohara; Itachi was never his student.

traps.ask: Since you sealed the whole Nine-Tails into Naruto, you never had any of it yourself, right?
traps.truth: He split Kurama: the Yang half went into Naruto and the Yin half went with Minato through the Reaper Death Seal.

real_events.ask: Remember the night Naruto was born, when you fought the masked man to protect the village?
Remember when you rescued Kushina from the Cloud ninja by following her red hair?
When you were reanimated, you got to the battlefield before the other Hokage and fought next to Naruto. How did that feel?

voice.ask: How are you feeling right now?
I'm scared I'll never be good at anything.
What's the secret to being so fast?
Do you have any advice for a new team leader?
